_comment: xhash16 instance parameters over the small STARK primes. skipbox distinguishes the XHash16 aggressive variant from XHash24; cpolys are the three coordinate polynomials of the degree-five extension power map, derived from the irreducible Mersenne-31 modulus fmod = X^3 + 5; M is the truncated Reed-Solomon circulant MDS. The named instances retain their supplied rcons table: schedule rows 0..8 and the final row (-1) are consumed. instances present: xhash16-m31-t24, xhash24-m31-t24.
